messages:
maya: Seeing customer reports of 502s from the text-generation endpoint after the morning runtime push. Root cause looks like a heap regression in the new memory allocator. Need an expedited hotfix and signoff to cut within 30m. Target image: redwood/textgen:hotfix-alloc-1.
devon: Can you own the rollout? We need explicit rollback criteria and whether any config flags change.
maya: I'll take deploy. No config changes. Rollback criteria: 502 rate +0.6% absolute vs baseline OR p95 latency >800ms for 3m OR any pod RSS >2.2GB for 2 nodes. Manual rollback only (ops consent required).
deploy-bot: Release request queued: redwood/textgen:hotfix-alloc-1. Canary plan default: 5% -> 10% (5m) -> 50% (5m) -> 100%. ETA 1755555600.
sre-oncall: Oncall ack. I'll monitor and can trigger rollback. Add incident tag: INC-1755-ALLOC.
pm-ops: Approving expedited deploy. Exclude apac-edge from canary due to bandwidth tests.
release-eng: Draft release-note blurb: "Fix memory allocator regression causing increased 502s under high-concurrency long requests; no migrations." Will publish after roll.
devon: Add an automated canary-snapshot check for RSS and p95, but leave final decision manual.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 1755555600 on pool textgen-canary-1 (5%).
maya: quick smoke inside canary: 502s down to 0.02% on canary nodes, p95 210ms, RSS ~1.1GB.
sre-oncall: Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood/s/textgen/hotfix-alloc-1. Watching errors and mem.
deploy-bot: Advanced to 10% at 1755555660. Holding 5m.
pm-ops: Confirm apac excluded. Good.
maya: Synthetic long-seq tests passing. Traces show allocator metrics stable.
devon: I give expedited approval to continue to 50% after hold if metrics stay steady.
deploy-bot: Advanced to 50% at 1755555700. Hold 5m verification.
sre-oncall: Observability note: small transient GC spike at 50% but no errors. Still within rollback thresholds.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% completed at 1755555710. No automated rollback.
maya: Deployed to prod. Monitoring 15m — no regressions, error rate back to baseline. Filing short incident summary and will update changelog.
release-eng: Final release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/1755555555-textgen-hotfix. Will post to #release-notes once incident summary is linked.
pm-ops: Thanks team, nice quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
